name: Selfhost Podcasting
author: Veda

sections.description:
Selfhost Podcasting is a clean and efficient WordPress plugin that helps you create and manage multiple podcast shows directly from your WordPress dashboard. It provides a clean and focused admin interface where you can enter podcast and episode details. The plugin then generates a fully formatted RSS feed that meets the technical specifications of Apple Podcasts and Spotify.

Watch this introductory video to learn about the Selfhost Podcasting.

Unlike bulky podcasting plugins that try to do everything, Selfhost Podcasting focuses on what really matters: your podcast feed. Whether you’re launching a single show or managing a podcast network, this plugin makes it easy to generate valid, standards-compliant RSS feeds for Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and other major directories.

Key Features

  • Create and manage multiple podcast shows from a single dashboard
  • Clean, distraction-free and well-organized input forms for entering podcast and episode metadata
  • Automatically generates podcast RSS feeds that comply with Apple and Spotify guidelines
  • Supports custom fields such as episode type, season, duration, and explicit flag
  • Lightweight with no impact on your site’s frontend
  • Full control of your podcast data within WordPress

Use Cases

  • Creators who want to host and distribute their podcast independently
  • Agencies managing podcasts for clients
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file and upload it to your WordPress site.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and choose the ZIP file.
  3. Click Install Now, then activate the plugin.
  4. After activation, go to Selfhost Podcasting in your WordPress admin menu to start creating your podcast feed.
  5. Add podcast-level details and then add episodes.
  6. The plugin will generate a valid RSS feed URL for each podcast you create.
sections.faq:
Can I create more than one podcast feed?

Yes, you can create multiple podcasts with their own separate feeds. Each feed is independent and fully customizable.

Are the feeds compatible with Apple Podcasts and Spotify?

Yes. The plugin generates RSS feeds that meet the requirements of both Apple Podcasts and Spotify, including fields like episode type, season, and explicit content flags.
